exposure: Tranexamic acid (1 gm IV before cesarean)
outcome: Blood loss (from placenta delivery to 2 hours post-labour, and from end of LSCS to 2 hours post-labour)
cohort: 100 women with planned cesarean sections between 37 and 40 weeks gestation, divided into two groups.
finding: Tranexamic acid significantly reduced blood loss during cesarean section without causing adverse reactions or thrombosis events.
